name: Build a Second Brain
tagline: Research that's sourced, filed, and findable months later.
rationale: Research only compounds if it's verified and findable later; otherwise it just scrolls past. This bundle gathers from real sources, checks the claims, files the dossiers with structure, and keeps your second brain briefed morning and night. Six months on you can still find what you learned and why it mattered.
